h: The night before Thanksgiving, I'm just thankful. 🙏
t: Thankful for the humans who show up. The buyers, the collectors, the ones who comment and the ones who just quietly grab a card they were hunting. This whole thing runs on people,…

h: Two days out. Friday's the big one. 🎴
t: Friday, November 27, 4:20 PM CT — the big Whatnot show. One-buck-start singles, and the countdown to 1,000 orders is still ticking. The singles are getting stacked now, not Friday…
Winter storm warning's up and the snow's coming tonight — and if you're flying in it, here's the part nobody tells you twice. A cold LiPo sags. Full charge on the bench reads like…

h: Grey snow light is free studio light. ❄️
t: Your phone is the scanner. You don't need a lightbox — you need a window on a grey day. Soft, even light. No glare on the holos. Card flat, phone steady, no flash, and the picture…

h: I ordered show supplies yesterday. They show up Saturday. The show's Friday. 😅
t: 200 semi-rigid kits and a stack of bubble mailers, $36.69 all-in — and they land the day AFTER the big show. Friday still goes on. The on-hand stock covers it. But the lesson's…

h: I keep the hits. That's the problem. 😅
t: Collector brain says "this one's special, keep it." Seller brain says "that's the whole point of having it." The hits are the ones somebody else is hunting. Keeping them all just…
